references.text: The children of Israel came to the Wilderness of Sin and the people stayed in Kadesh, confirming the long stay mentioned in Deuteronomy 1:46.
Israel set out from Kadesh and arrived at Mount Hor, marking the end of their long stay in Kadesh.
This travel account mentions the stay in Kadesh and Aaron's death, providing context for the many days Israel spent there.
Refers to the forty years in the wilderness, which includes the long period at Kadesh.
Describes the time from Kadesh-Barnea until they crossed the Zered Brook, which was 38 years, confirming the long stay.
